clauses.clause: Sole clause: modifies the Executive Order of June 8, 1926 (Reservoir Site Reserve No. 17) so the Federal Power Commission may license transmission-line power projects on the listed Granite Dyke Reservoir Site lands, on condition that licensees remove works within thirty days of notice from the Secretary of the Interior when the lands are required for reservoir purposes.

The order only modifies the 1926 parent order, to let the Federal Power Commission license transmission lines.

review.conclusion_reason: OPEN correctly reflects the missing status of the parent reservation as applied to these lands and the absence of positive cutoff evidence. The correction supplies no ending. Formal status is supported only as the limited finding that no express ending was found in the reviewed evidence, not proof that none exists.
review.stop_code_verdict: confirmed — NOT_FOUND fits the first gap: the evidence slice supplies neither the parent’s disposition for these lands nor current operative evidence. Its purported later instrument is only the separately printed correction. The acknowledged unopened leads limit search completeness but do not resolve that gap.

verdicts.reason: The held EO_7651.txt prints the July 1 signature date, order number 7651, and July 2 filing date on FR page 1379.
The operative sentence modifies the June 8, 1926 reservation to permit Federal Power Commission transmission-line licenses and amendments; the adjacent revocation belongs to EO 7652.
The cited text requires removal at licensees’ expense within thirty days after notice from the Secretary of the Interior when reservoir purposes require the lands.
The held printing identifies the San Bernardino Meridian and Granite Dyke Reservoir Site, San Gabriel River, followed by the cited township heading.

EO_7678.txt contains a separately headed Correction explicitly naming EO 7651 and replacing the top-of-column land description. Comparison confirms the township changes from T. 1 N. to T. 2 N.; no termination is stated.
The complete correction lists described portions of sections 13, 22, 23, and 24 beneath T. 2 N., R. 10 W. These are not grants covering the entire sections.
The quoted operative sentence identifies the parent by date and reserve number. Applying the supplied amendment-only rule requires establishing that parent’s status.
